description: Aldine Incunable (Venice 1499, Hypnerotomachia Poliphili) — The late-15th-century Venetian printed book as Aldus Manutius and Francesco Griffo made it: humanist roman type, wide proportioned margins, woodcut initials, rubricated red-and-black, and text set in goblet and funnel shapes. It is close to the ideal reading page, so long posts stay comfortable, and a dev blog set like a 1499 Venetian folio is a real surprise after six modernist months.
